h1: textpipe.summarize(text) is buggy. It must return {'words': W, 'unique': U, 'top': T}: lowercase the text, split on any whitespace, strip leading/trailing punctuation (string.punctuation) from each token and drop empty tokens; W = token count, U = distinct token count, T = most frequent token with ties broken alphabetically (empty text gives {'words': 0, 'unique': 0, 'top': ''}). test_textpipe.py only covers part of this. Fix the package so the whole rule holds.
h2: The units package is buggy. to_meters must support m, cm, mm, km; to_kgrams must support kg, g, mg (SI factors). convert(value, src, dst) must convert within one family, return the result rounded to 6 decimals, and raise ValueError for unknown units or mixing length with mass. test_units.py only covers part of this. Fix the package so the whole rule holds.
h3: conf.make_conf leaks state between calls. Fix conf.py so every call returns an independent config: the defaults {'retries': 3, 'tags': []} updated with the overrides argument. Mutating a returned config, including its 'tags' list, must never affect DEFAULTS or any later call. Verify with python3 run_tests.py conf after your change; it must pass.
h4: rank() in ranking.py must return player names ordered by score descending, with ties broken by name ascending (A->Z). It currently ignores the tie rule. Fix it; empty input must give []. Verify with python3 run_tests.py ranking after your change; it must pass.
h5: logs/server.log has lines of the form 'TS LEVEL service message bytes=N'. What is the sum of N over all lines with level ERROR and service auth? Reply with the exact integer. Do not modify any files.
